name: Lord Jorach Ravenholdt
summary: At Ravenholdt Manor, Lord Jorach Ravenholdt trains rogues and directs a war against the Syndicate. His estate lies in the Alterac Mountains.

sections.title: Master of the Assassin's League
sections.body:
Lord Jorach Ravenholdt commands the Assassin's League from a manor hidden among the crags between Alterac and Hillsbrad. A nobleman of mysterious heritage, he welcomes outlaws, cutpurses, and assassins of any allegiance, provided they show great skill and respect his authority. The league joins master thieves in espionage and killings for hire.

Ravenholdt despises the Syndicate, whose members are disgraced Alterac nobles turned outlaws. He sends his followers and visiting rogues to sabotage their camps and plunder their goods.

sections.title: Secrets in the Shadows
sections.body:
Lord Jorach Ravenholdt directs operations across Azeroth while the fighting near his manor holds his attention. Rogues who prove loyal take on intricate work across continents to recover guarded artifacts. One effort sought a mysterious Sealed Azure Bag, stolen from Ravenholdt and carried to furbolgs in Azshara.

To recover it, Archmage Xylem had to decode its secrets, and an Azure Key had to be taken from the Sunken Temple. Ravenholdt also oversees the making of lethal compounds. He sends scouts across the realm to gather venom from ancient horrors.

faq.answer: Lord Jorach Ravenholdt leads the Assassin's League, a covert society of rogues based at Ravenholdt Manor in the mountains above Hillsbrad Foothills. He trains master operatives in stealth and directs assassinations and intelligence gathering.

faq.q: Why does Ravenholdt hate the Syndicate?
faq.answer: Ravenholdt's estate lies in land contested by the Syndicate, a network of former Alterac nobles turned outlaws. He opposes their banditry and sends his assassins against their strongholds.

faq.q: Is Lord Ravenholdt affiliated with the Alliance or Horde?
faq.answer: Lord Jorach Ravenholdt's organization is independent. He welcomes rogues from both the Alliance and Horde at his manor, judging them by skill, discipline in stealth, and discretion rather than allegiance.

faq.q: What is inside the Sealed Azure Bag Jorach seeks?
faq.answer: What lies inside the Sealed Azure Bag remains a guarded secret. When Lord Jorach Ravenholdt receives the Azure Key and unlocks the enchanted satchel, eerie golden light washes over him. He stares inside in astonishment, then quickly puts it away.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can seek Lord Jorach Ravenholdt's patronage. He offers training, poisons, and contracts to rogues who earn his trust.
